label: Deadlift one-rep max
definition: Heaviest weight a person can deadlift from the floor for a single repetition, in kilograms, taken as the best successful raw (unequipped) deadlift at a sanctioned powerlifting meet.
phrasings: what deadlift is top 1% for men
how rare is a 500 lb deadlift
how much can the strongest 1% deadlift
